title: Handle parent-children orphans cleanly on invalidate --retarget and distinct invalidated mode

sections.what: Preserve or retarget parent/children hierarchy edges cleanly when an epic or parent task is invalidated, and surface distinct invalidated status semantics rather than collapsing into superseded.
sections.why: apply_invalidation currently sets status to superseded even in --mode invalidated, and --retarget rewires blocked_by/depends_on while leaving child subtasks pointing at a dead parent.
sections.how: Update graph.py apply_invalidation and presets/schema so invalidated can optionally stay distinct or cascade/reparent open children cleanly.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_graph_invalidation.py with parent/children retarget cases.

acceptance.text: invalidate --retarget warns on or rewires open child subtasks onto the replacement parent
mode=invalidated semantics are clearly represented and tested

evidence: Updated graph.py apply_invalidation to preserve distinct status='invalidated', emit open-child orphan warnings, and reparent open children onto replacement when retarget_dependents=True.
Added 'invalidated' to DEFAULT_STATUSES/DEFAULT_TERMINAL_STATUSES in models.py and core/strict/virtualworld preset templates.
